page_title: HOF 2-3 LEV | Hoffenheim v Bayer Leverkusen 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
90+5' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+2' A player from Bayer Leverkusen commits a rough challenge. Frank Willenborg blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+1' Here is a change. Florian Wirtz is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Jeremie Frimpong, but he puts too much power on the pass.
89' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukas Hradecky, who smothers the ball.
88' Substitution. Victor Boniface makes his way off the pitch and Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as his replacement.
88' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) replaces Kevin Akpoguma.
87' Substitution. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) in, Maximilian Beier out.
87' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
86' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
85' The attendance is 30150.
81' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
81' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) touches the ball with his hand.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonas Hofmann leaves the pitch and Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
79' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
78' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Robert Skov and he is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
78' Today's match ends for Finn Ole Becker who will be replaced by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
78' Frank Willenborg blows for a foul after Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
75' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
74' Now Hoffenheim have a corner.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
72' Lukas Hradecky (Bayer Leverkusen) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

70' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Victor Boniface provided an assist for the goal.
69' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
65' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
64' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
60' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
58' 2 - 2 Goal! Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:2.

56' 1 - 2 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 1:2.
52' The ball goes out for a corner. Hoffenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
48' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
46' Xabi Alonso makes a switch. Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) is coming on in place of Odilon Kossounou at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Although Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) is just on the bench, Frank Willenborg has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' 0 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Jonas Hofmann delivers the corner, Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes inside the left post and past the helpless goalkeeper. 0:2.
45+1' The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
44' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
40' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
40' It looks like Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Frank Willenborg won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
39' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' A brilliant individual effort! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
34' The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
33' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
31' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
28' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Frank Willenborg has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Victor Boniface, but he puts too much power on the pass.
23' Good defending. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Victor Boniface inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
22' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
19' The game is interrupted now, Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:3.
15' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

13' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Victor Boniface tees up Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hoffenheim.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
Frank Willenborg is the one to supervise the game today.
